Name: Cosmic Fat Ass - Little Debbie Snack Dealer
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b][size=4]Cosmic Fatass by CosmicSweetpea[/size][/b]

[b]Inspired by my former coping mechanism, when I was big back 3,000.[/b]

Meet Pelican Town’s newest highly questionable entrepreneur the Snack Dealer. Cosmic Fatass adds a custom snack dealer to the Stardrop Saloon every [b]Friday, Saturday, and Sunday[/b]. She sells Little Debbie favorites, homemade snack ingredients, and a suspicious amount of Hostess merchandise she is absolutely not authorized to carry. She is hustling. Do not ask where the Hostess inventory came from.
